paymentLabels.summarySimulated: Simulated payment — your order will be placed immediately without charging any real payment method.
paymentLabels.summarySsl: You will be redirected to our payment partner (SSL Commerz) to complete payment. Your order stays pending until payment succeeds.
paymentLabels.summaryCod: No online payment step — you will pay when your order is delivered. Your order is confirmed as unpaid until cash is collected.

shipping.emptyBody: Your administrator needs at least one active shipping method for your zone in Payload Admin (Shipping → Shipping Methods). Takeaway, cash on delivery, and courier are modeled as separate methods—clear names help shoppers choose.
shipping.selectAllGroupsError: Please select shipping methods for all groups.

outcomes.successSubtitleCod: Thank you. You'll pay when your order is delivered.
outcomes.codPaymentBanner: Cash on delivery — please keep payment ready for the courier. Your order stays unpaid in our system until cash is collected on delivery.
outcomes.successFallbackBody: We couldn't restore full order details in this browser (for example after switching devices or clearing storage).
outcomes.successFallbackTrackHint: Use Track order with your email or phone and this reference if needed.
outcomes.saveOrderNumberHint: Save this order number for tracking and support.
outcomes.failedWithRef: The payment gateway did not confirm payment{{refSuffix}}. Your order may still exist as unpaid. You can return to checkout to try again, or contact support with any receipt from your bank or wallet.
outcomes.failedGeneric: The payment gateway did not confirm payment. If you closed the payment tab early or lost connection, try again from checkout. If money left your account, contact support with your receipt.
outcomes.cancelWithRef: You left the payment page before completing checkout{{refSuffix}}. No charge was completed through our gateway.
outcomes.cancelGeneric: You left the payment page before completing checkout. No charge was completed through our gateway.
